import sys

def find_different_permutation(p):
    n = len(p)
    if n == 2:
        return [p[1], p[0]]
    
    # Create a list of pairs (sum, index)
    pairs = [(p[i] + p[i+1], i) for i in range(n-1)]
    pairs.sort()
    
    # Find the first pair where the sum is the same
    for i in range(1, n-1):
        if pairs[i][0] == pairs[i-1][0]:
            # Swap the elements at the indices of these pairs
            j, k = pairs[i-1][1], pairs[i][1]
            p[j], p[k] = p[k], p[j]
            return p
    
    # If no such pair is found, swap the first two elements
    return [p[1], p[0]] + p[2:]

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read

    index += 1

        index += 1
        p = list(map(int, data[index:index+n]))
        index += n
        p_prime = find_different_permutation(p)
        results.append(" ".join(map(str, p_prime)))
    
    print("\n".join(results))
